Questions

Answers before you even ask

Do you build both static and dynamic websites? +

Yes. We build static-first websites for speed and SEO — marketing sites, landing pages, and content platforms — and fully dynamic websites and web applications with dashboards, logins, databases, and APIs when your business needs them.

Which IT services does Btechwale provide? +

Btechwale is a full-stack IT services partner: web development (static and dynamic), custom software and web applications, SEO services, ecommerce development, AI development, business automation, UI/UX design, and ongoing website maintenance and support.

Do you work with businesses outside India? +

Yes. We are an India-first studio serving clients globally — including the USA, UAE, UK, Australia, and Singapore — with remote-friendly delivery, clear communication, and timezone-overlap working hours.

Will my website be SEO-ready from day one? +

Every build ships with clean semantic HTML, fast Core Web Vitals, canonical URLs, XML sitemaps, structured data (schema), and metadata foundations — so search engines can crawl, understand, and rank your pages from launch.

How much does website development cost in India? +

It depends on scope: a static business website costs far less than a dynamic web application with custom features. Share your requirements through the contact page and we will send a clear, itemized estimate — no hidden costs.

Do you provide website maintenance and support? +

Yes. We offer ongoing maintenance plans covering updates, security, backups, performance monitoring, content changes, and SEO health checks so your website keeps improving after launch.
